instructions: Does the changed code satisfy each acceptance criterion in the task, without relying on a self-declared pass? Assess supplied review findings against the task, frozen diff and observed public tests: findings are model claims, not observed failures. Do not invent requirements or turn optional improvements into blockers. A grounded material correctness, security, data-loss or required-acceptance defect contradicts satisfaction; unresolved evidence is not approval.

criteria.true: Every required criterion has a correct implementation path and no supplied finding establishes a material blocking defect
criteria.false: At least one required criterion remains unaddressed or contradicted by the code or grounded review evidence
